arxiv-1906-02818.title: Tensor Processing Units for Financial Monte Carlo
arxiv-1906-02818.creator: Francois Belletti, Davis King, Kun Yang, Roland Nelet, Yusef Shafi, Yi-Fan Chen, John Anderson
arxiv-1906-02818.description: Abstract Monte Carlo methods are critical to many routines in quantitative finance such as derivatives pricing, hedging and risk metrics. Unfortunately, Monte Carlo methods are very computationally expensive when it comes to running simulations in high-dimensional state spaces where they are still a method of choice in the financial industry.

arxiv-1908-03918.title: DynaNet: Neural Kalman Dynamical Model for Motion Estimation and Prediction
arxiv-1908-03918.creator: Changhao Chen, Chris Xiaoxuan Lu, Bing Wang, Niki Trigoni, Andrew Markham
arxiv-1908-03918.description: Abstract Dynamical models estimate and predict the temporal evolution of physical systems. State Space Models (SSMs) in particular represent the system dynamics with many desirable properties, such as being able to model uncertainty in both the model and measurements, and optimal (in the Bayesian sense) recursive formulations e.g. the Kalman Filter.

arxiv-2103-04078.title: A wavelet uncertainty principle in quantum calculus
arxiv-2103-04078.creator: Sabrine Arfaoui, Maryam G. Alshehri, Anouar Ben Mabrouk
arxiv-2103-04078.description: Abstract In the present paper, a new uncertainty principle is derived for the generalized q q -Bessel wavelet transform studied earlier in [ 55 ] . In this paper, an uncertainty principle associated with wavelet transforms in the q q -calculus framework has been established.

arxiv-2103-11850.title: Monitoring Covid-19 on social media using a novel triage and diagnosis approach
arxiv-2103-11850.creator: Abul Hasan, Mark Levene, David Weston, Renate Fromson, Nicolas Koslover, Tamara Levene
arxiv-2103-11850.description: Abstract Background: The COVID-19 pandemic has created a pressing need for integrating information from disparate sources, in order to assist decision makers. Social media is important in this respect, however, to make sense of the textual information it provides and be able to automate the processing of large amounts of data, natural language processing methods are needed.

arxiv-2104-13068.title: Optimal conditions for ( L 1 ; L 2 ) (L_{1};L_{2}) to be forcibly bigraphic Thanks: This work is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China(NSFC11921001,11601108) and the National Key Research and Development Program of China(2018YFA0704701). The authors are grateful to professor
arxiv-2104-13068.creator: Jiyun Guo, Yuqin Zhang
arxiv-2104-13068.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jiyun Guo, Yuqin Zhang. Let L_{1}=([a_{1},b_{1}],\ldots,[a_{m},b_{m}]) and L_{2}=([c_{1},d_{1}],\ldots,[c_{n},d_{n}] ) be two sequences of intervals consisting of nonnegative integers with b_{1}\geq\cdots\geq b_{m} and d_{1}\geq\cdots\geq d_{n} . In this paper, we first give two optimal conditions for the sequences of intervals L_{1} and L_{2} such that each pair (P;Q) with P=(p_{1},\ldots,p_{m}) , Q=(q_{1},\ldots,q_{n}) , a_{i}\leq p_{i}\leq b_{i} for 1\leq i\leq m , c_{i}\leq q_{i}\leq d_{i} for 1\leq i\leq n and \sum\limits_{i=1}^{m}p_{i}=\sum\limits_{i=1}^{n}q_{i} is bigraphic.

arxiv-2109-12084.title: Pseudogauge dependence of the spin polarization and of the axial vortical effect
arxiv-2109-12084.creator: M. Buzzegoli
arxiv-2109-12084.description: Abstract The mean spin polarization vector of spin 1/2 particles in a relativistic fluid at local thermal equilibrium (LTE) in different pseudogauges (PGs), i.e., with different choices for the decomposition of orbital and spin angular momentum, is obtained. The spin polarization obtained in the canonical PG differs from the one obtained in the Belinfante PG.

arxiv-2408-15171.title: Measuring text summarization factuality using atomic facts entailment metrics in the context of retrieval augmented generation
arxiv-2408-15171.creator: Nicolas Kriman F
arxiv-2408-15171.description: Abstract Large language models (LLM) use has exploded since the introduction of ChatGPT in 2022, and it’s value has been evident in many use cases. One of its main barriers for enterprise/commercial use is its tendency to “make up” facts when answering, known as “hallucination”.

arxiv-2409-00921.title: Statically Contextualizing Large Language Models with Typed Holes
arxiv-2409-00921.creator: Andrew Blinn, Xiang Li, June Hyung Kim, Cyrus Omar
arxiv-2409-00921.description: Abstract . Large language models (LLMs) have reshaped the landscape of program synthesis. However, contemporary LLM-based code completion systems often hallucinate broken code because they lack appropriate code context, particularly when working with definitions that are neither in the training data nor near the cursor.

arxiv-2504-05540.title: Tail probability of maximal displacement in critical and subcritical branching stable processes
arxiv-2504-05540.creator: Haojie Hou, Yiyang Jiang, Yan-Xia Ren, and, Renming Song
arxiv-2504-05540.description: Abstract In this paper, we study critical and subcritical branching α \alpha -stable processes, α ∈ ( 0 , 2 ) \alpha\in(0,2) . We obtain the exact asymptotic behaviors of the tails of the maximal positions of all subcritical branching α \alpha -stable processes with positive jumps.

arxiv-2509-17278.title: Gauge-invariant absolute quantification of electric and magnetic multipole densities in crystals
arxiv-2509-17278.creator: R. Winkler, U. Zülicke
arxiv-2509-17278.description: Abstract Electric and magnetic multipole densities in crystalline solids, including the familiar electric dipole density in ferroelectrics and the magnetic dipole density in ferromagnets, are of central importance for our understanding of ordered phases in matter. However, determining the magnitude of these quantities has proven to be conceptually and technically difficult.

arxiv-2512-17410.title: Kinetic-Theory Bounds on the Equation of State of Dense QCD Matter
arxiv-2512-17410.creator: Michał Marczenko
arxiv-2512-17410.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Michał Marczenko. We derive bounds on the equation of state of cold, dense matter by extending the causal, model-agnostic interpolation between chiral effective field theory and perturbative calculations with a microscopic constraint from relativistic kinetic theory. The additional condition restricts the stiffest admissible behavior of the equation of state and systematically reduces the range of allowed equations of state, with the strongest effect at high densities.

pmc-11629148.title: The correlation between Diabetes and age-related degeneration and the static and dynamic 3D mechanical distribution of different plantar regions
pmc-11629148.creator: Xiong-gang Yang, Xing-xi Hu, Qi-yang Wang, Zhi Peng, Hao-tian Luo, Sheng Lu
pmc-11629148.description: PurposeThis study aimed to compare the distribution of plantar pressure and anterior-posterior (AP) or medial-lateral (ML) shear forces in healthy younger (HY) people, healthy older (HO) people, and diabetic patients, both in static standing and during gait.Materials and methodsA total of 20 HY adults, 16 HO adults and 15 diabetic patients were included.

pmc-11680048.title: Feasibility and Preliminary Efficacy of Co-Designed and Co-Created Healthy Lifestyle Social Media Intervention Programme the Daily Health Coach for Young Women: A Pilot Randomised Controlled Trial
pmc-11680048.creator: Jessica A. Malloy, Stephanie R. Partridge, Joya A. Kemper, Andrea Braakhuis, Rajshri Roy
pmc-11680048.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Young women spend 50 min daily on social media (SM); thus, SM platforms are promising for health interventions. This study tested the feasibility and preliminary efficacy of the co-designed SM intervention the Daily Health Coach (DHC). The DHC is a 3-month healthy lifestyles intervention programme, targeting eating, physical activity, and social wellbeing behaviours in women aged 18–24, via the dissemination of health and nutrition content on social media platform Instagram.

pmc-12717426.title: Integrative analysis of pancreatic microbiota and metabolome in patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
pmc-12717426.creator: Yiqing Zhu, Xiao Liang, Feng Li, Jianwei Xu, Changxu Chen, Haoyun Tang, Yifan Wang, Lixiang Li, Luping Xing, Yanyan Dong, Zhen Li
pmc-12717426.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The importance of microbiota-associated metabolites in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) tumorigenesis highlights the need to investigate the microbiota and metabolome along the normal-adjacent-carcinoma sequence to explore their mechanistic implications in PDAC tumorigenesis. We characterized the pancreatic microbiota and metabolome in four distinct tissue groups using 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing and untargeted metabolomics: tumor tissues from 23 PDAC patients (PDAC T), their matched para-carcinoma tissues (PCT), tumor tissues from 13 pancreatic benign tumor patients (Control T), and their matched non-tumor tissues (Control N).

pmc-13187411.title: Machine learning surrogate for the leaf PROSPECT-D model and its applications across plant species
pmc-13187411.creator: Milad Rahimi-Majd, Rudan Xu, Stefan Bauermeister, Zoran Nikoloski
pmc-13187411.description: Leaf hyperspectral reflectance (HSR) data have gained increasing attention due to their usage in predicting a range of leaf physiological, biochemical, structural, and photosynthetic traits using machine learning (ML) models. The PROSPECT family of models offers a complementary, mechanistic means to estimate leaf traits from HSR data using model inversion.

pmc-13383497.title: Development and validation of an Online Comprehensive Geriatric Screening (O-CGS) Tool
pmc-13383497.creator: Supakorn Chansaengpetch, Ornicha Thititagul, Somboon Intalapaporn, Narongpon Dumavibhat, Angkana Jongsawadipatana, Orawan Supapueng, Arunotai Siriussawakul, Piyapat Dajpratham, Varalak Srinonprasert, Prapat Suriyaphol, Suwannee Suraseranivongse, Visit Vamvanij, Weerasak Muangpaisan
pmc-13383497.description: BackgroundThe healthcare landscape is undergoing a significant transformation through digitalization. Embracing digital technology presents an opportunity to enhance the health and well-being of older adults. Therefore, this study aimed to develop and evaluate the validity and usability of an online comprehensive geriatric screening (O-CGS) tool for intrinsic capacity declines.

pmc-13644789.title: More than just smiling: how positive emotions are expressed on the face
pmc-13644789.creator: Kunalan Manokara, Irene Teulings, YongQi Cong, Roza Kamiloğlu, Agneta H Fischer, Disa A Sauter
pmc-13644789.description: To advance the science of positive emotional expressions, we test how 22 positive emotions are spontaneously displayed on the face, using the participant-negotiated episodic recall method. Respondents (n = 163) narrated emotional events from their lives, and we extracted facial behaviours that reflected peak expressivity (35 410 facial actions).

uslaw-usc-t12-s1716.title: 12 U.S.C. § 1716 — Declaration of purposes of subchapter

uslaw-usc-t12-s1716.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 13 (National Housing); Subchapter III (National Mortgage Associations). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Congress declares that the purposes of this subchapter are to establish secondary market facilities for residential mortgages, to provide that the operations thereof shall be financed by private capital to the maximum extent feasible, and to authorize such facilities.
